# scripts/Visual/Blowhole.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Visual/Blowhole.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Periodic cave spray and recorded roar (FilmCow sea; tools/prepare_sfx.py).
During roar_time, a SoundBus box masks gameplay noise by roar_db; exit removes the zone.
The radial spray texture is generated locally.

Base: `Node3D`. Registered class: `none`.
